ac_risk_low.title: Clean screening gives low risk
given: a screening result with no sanctions match, no PEP and no adverse media
the client's country risk is standard
then: the risk rating is low
the case goes straight to recording

provenance.excerpt: Otherwise it's low

ac_risk_high.title: Sanctions match or PEP gives high risk
given: a screening result where a director is a PEP
then: the risk rating is high
the case goes to the MLRO for approval

provenance.excerpt: Any sanctions match or a PEP makes it high risk

ac_risk_medium.title: Adverse media gives medium risk
given: a screening result with adverse media but no sanctions match or PEP
then: the risk rating is medium
the case goes to an analyst for approval

provenance.excerpt: Adverse media or a high-risk country makes it medium

ac_docs_overdue.title: No documents after 10 working days puts onboarding on hold
given: a client who has not sent their KYC documents 10 working days after the request
then: the engagement manager is notified
onboarding for the client is set to on hold

provenance.excerpt: After 10 working days with no documents, the engagement manager is told and onboarding is put on hold.

ac_request_docs.title: Document request sent through the portal
given: a new client record in the CRM
then: the client receives a portal request listing photo ID and proof of address for each director and owner
the request is due 5 working days after sending

ac_chase_docs.title: Reminders follow the agreed schedule
given: a client who has not sent their documents 5 working days after the request
when: the reminder schedule runs each working day
then: a reminder is sent on day 5
a further reminder is sent every 3 working days until the documents arrive

ac_verify_id.title: Valid ID is verified automatically
given: a valid passport for each director
then: a verification result is recorded for each director
the case moves on to screening

ac_id_check_failed.title: Failed ID check goes to an analyst
given: an expired passport for one director
then: the case is placed in the analyst's queue with the reason
screening does not start until the analyst clears it

ac_screen_clear.title: Clean screening moves on automatically
given: a client and owners with no possible matches
then: the screening result is saved to the client file
the case moves on to the risk rating

ac_screen_possible_match.title: Possible match is reviewed by an analyst
given: a director with a possible PEP match
then: the case waits for an analyst to confirm or clear the match
the analyst's decision and reason are saved

ac_analyst_approved.title: Analyst approves a medium-risk client
given: a medium-risk client because of adverse media
when: the analyst approves the client with a reason
then: the approval, approver and reason are saved
the outcome moves on to be recorded

ac_analyst_rejected.title: Analyst escalates a medium-risk client to the MLRO
given: a medium-risk client the analyst is not comfortable accepting
then: the case goes to the MLRO for approval with the analyst's reason

ac_mlro_approved.title: MLRO approves a high-risk client
given: a high-risk client because a director is a PEP
then: the approval, approver and date are saved
the outcome moves on to be recorded

ac_mlro_rejected.title: MLRO rejects a high-risk client
given: a high-risk client with a sanctions match
then: nothing is recorded as KYC complete
the engagement manager is asked to decline the client

ac_record_kyc.title: KYC outcome and evidence recorded
given: a client whose rating is low, or approved where needed
then: the CRM shows KYC complete with the rating
the documents, screening results and approvals are kept on the client file

ac_decline.title: Engagement manager declines the client
given: a client the MLRO has rejected
when: the engagement manager declines the client
then: the client is told the firm cannot act
the client record is marked declined

ac_crm_unavailable.title: CRM outage retries, then goes to an analyst
given: the CRM is unavailable when a KYC outcome is ready to record
then: recording is retried up to 3 times
after the third failure the case is placed in the analyst's queue
nothing is marked KYC complete until the CRM write succeeds

provenance.excerpt: retry a few times, then put it in the analyst's queue

term_kyc.definition: Know your client: checks that confirm who a client and its owners are, and the risk they pose.

provenance.excerpt: Client KYC checks

in: KYC for new corporate clients: documents, ID verification, screening, risk rating, approval and recording
out: The final decision on high-risk clients (stays with the MLRO)
Periodic KYC refresh for existing clients (later phase)
assumptions: New clients in scope are companies
